## color.cyclic-palette (0.1.0)

Immutable ordered opaque sRGB8 palette sampled by a phase in cycles, with linear encoded-channel interpolation and fixed RGB24 quantization.

Contract status: reviewed.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "colors"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "colors": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 2147483647,
      "items": {
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 0,
        "maximum": 16777215
      }
    }
  }
}
```

| parameter | unit | default | encouraged range | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| colors | ordered RGB24 values (0xRRGGBB encoded sRGB8) | null | null | mountain4#2, pelines#1 and Cuadricula#1 use ordered colour lists. Preserve caller artwork and duplicate entries. RGB24 and opaque-only scope are portable design choices, not a claim about every host colour type. Nonempty length <=2^31-1 is a cross-target index representability bound, not an artistic range or allocation guarantee. |
| phase | cycles through the whole palette | null | null | Source helpers use entry coordinates; public cycles remove palette-length coupling. mountain4 dc random(0.099,0.1) -> random(0.3,0.4) reports moderate colour change with fixed geometry, but does not establish a recommended phase/rate range. pelines palette replacement changes background too; Cuadricula experiments are unscored. |

Query input (native call forms are specified in the contract):

```json
{
  "type": "number",
  "minimum": -1.7976931348623157e+308,
  "maximum": 1.7976931348623157e+308
}
```

Query result:

```json
{
  "type": "integer",
  "minimum": 0,
  "maximum": 16777215
}
```

`null` means no default or encouraged range is approved.

Current implementation status comes from a separately reviewed attestation, not this immutable contract.

## topology.delaunay-2d (0.1.0)

Produce owned exact planar Delaunay topology from an ordered finite binary64 site list and explicit deterministic work budget. It computes canonical unique vertices, input mappings, positive indexed faces, unique edges and final face incidence only; it has no random stream, renderer, palette, clipping, site sampler or draw side effect.

Contract status: reviewed.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "points": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 0,
      "maxItems": 357913943,
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/point"
      }
    },
    "maxWork": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "points",
    "maxWork"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$defs": {
    "point": {
      "type": "array",
      "prefixItems": [
        {
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "type": "number"
        }
      ],
      "items": false,
      "minItems": 2,
      "maxItems": 2
    }
  }
}
```

| parameter | unit | default | encouraged range | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| points | ordered finite binary64 Cartesian coordinate pairs | null | null | Supplied point sets are the geometric input boundary selected from datata#0 and lightcity#1. The operation neither samples sites nor derives an artistic density. |
| maxWork | charged deterministic schedule units | null | null | Engineering admission for bounded deterministic topology work; it is not a source artistic parameter or timing/heap estimate. |

`null` means no default or encouraged range is approved.

Current implementation status comes from a separately reviewed attestation, not this immutable contract.

## path.gradient-trace-2d (0.1.0)

Retain a finite two-dimensional trajectory by sampling an explicit gradient field at each evolving position and advancing a fixed distance. Reuse its positions and headings for different marks.

Contract status: reviewed.

```json

        }

      ],

    },
    "start": {
      "type": "array",
      "prefixItems": [
        {
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "type": "number"
        }
      ],
      "items": false,
      "minItems": 2,
      "maxItems": 2
    },
    "steps": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 1073741822
    },
    "stepDistance": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "fieldScale": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "fieldOffset": {
      "type": "array",
      "prefixItems": [
        {
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "type": "number"
        }
      ],
      "items": false,
      "minItems": 2,
      "maxItems": 2
    },
    "angleBase": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "angleScale": {
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "field",
    "start",
    "steps",
    "stepDistance",
    "fieldScale",
    "fieldOffset",
    "angleBase",
    "angleScale"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

| parameter | unit | default | encouraged range | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| field | seed-only gradient configuration | null | null | Existing named field; technique substitution for source simplex/Processing noise. No RNG draws or host noise. |
| start | coordinate pair | null | null | Explicit seed location; ciserp grid starts and natalata overscan motivate separating start placement from motion. |
| steps | advances | null | null | Ciserp reports2000–16000 steps; natalata2000–2800; mantel~338. No common encouraged interval. Representational ceiling derives from packed signed32-indexable position storage, not visual data. |
| stepDistance | coordinate distance per advance | null | null | Mantel describes1px advances and natalata0.4*scale. CP2 prototype uses0.4. Nonnegative forward displacement with zero stationary is a design convention; no recommended interval. |
| fieldScale | field lattice units per coordinate unit | null | null | Ciserp det substitutions change the source scene; private gradient experiment compared0.002 and0.01, with horizontal locking at finer scale. No common range or isotropy claim. |
| fieldOffset | field lattice coordinate pair | null | null | Explicit sampling translation as in ciserp des. Independent x/y offsets are a design generalization, not a measured range. |
| angleBase | radians | null | null | Ciserp heading includes ang; explicit affine offset. Prototype -20 is example configuration only. |
| angleScale | radians per field scalar unit | null | null | Ciserp amp changes a randomized distribution; it is not a scalar range. Prototype40 with gradient[0,1] is a technique-level choice, not signed simplex equivalence. |

`null` means no default or encouraged range is approved.

## mesh.radial-profile-surface-3d (0.1.0)

Generate an owned indexed-triangle radial surface from a caller-supplied ordered local axial radius profile, angular subdivision, independent endpoint closures, and explicit face bound. It computes retained local geometry, topology metadata, and flat unit normals only.

| parameter | unit | default | encouraged range | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| profile | ordered local [z,radius] pairs | null | null | cilindros motivates constant connected rings; fieeee motivates nonconstant caller profile; Circo motivates ordered bands. Private cylinder/waist/point profiles are configurations, not presets or a continuous range. |

## motion.target-springs-2d (0.1.0)

Advance an ordered independent target-spring state by one explicit logical step: target force, position using updated velocity, then velocity retention. State carries each body's position, velocity and coefficients. Native execution owns a mutable fixed-size batch with atomic steps and detached observations; no pointer, clock, RNG, renderer, topology or convergence guarantee.

| position | caller coordinate pair | null | null | Source pos; explicit arbitrary initial positions enable external layouts and snapshot restore. Finite binary64 model, no clipping. |

Per-body strength is explicit independent-system generalization. evidence/parameter-experiments/cp10-spring-response/decision.md |

Mathematical0..1 keeps/discards velocity; no inversion/amplification model. No stability or default claim. evidence/parameter-experiments/cp10-spring-response/decision.md |
| targets | one caller coordinate pair per body per step | null | null | Source target return and pointer force are separate example policies; supplied targets remove host-global input. No coefficient, seed, time or palette mutation. |
